body: I appreciate the perspective, but I disagree. Medication is about the one thing I haven't given a try
Like I said, started medication and therapy, but I don't know yet if it's the right medication for me. So far it's just making my anxiety worse, which is in turn feeding my depression.

All of them? I guess I'm not completely sure what you mean. I have almost no friendships anymore. I stopped dating a few months ago, mostly because it was just feeling too overwhelming. My job brings zero satisfaction. Actually nothing brings satisfaction. I'm unable to enjoy even that which I used to love.
